Adaptation
L4 — Reactive
The system has a nervous system. Events fire → the right handler runs → results feed back. A push triggers an audit. A failure triggers a self-heal. No human needed for the known cases.

But here's the ceiling: it only knows what you taught it. New failure modes go unnoticed. The system can't learn from its own history. That's the gap L5 fills.
bionicbanker.tech — The difference between automation and adaptation is a feedback loop.
